basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old graphic designer living in Portland, Oregon. I've always had a passion for art and design, which led me to a fulfilling career in web design. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the Pacific Northwest, experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen, and, of course, spending time with my two cats, Luna and Zephyr. I'm currently in a relationship with my partner of five years. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I love discovering new design trends, exploring creative communities, and indulging in cute cat content.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from the University of Oregon. Over the years, I've honed my skills in web design through both formal education and practical experience. I'm particularly skilled in using tools like Adobe Creative Suite and Webflow, which I learned through online courses and hands-on projects.
